description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic edged with gold and dark embroidery at the neckline, cuffs and hem. A deep plum outer robe and a broad matching drape cross the upper chest and hang from one shoulder, held by a round purple-centered gold clasp. Extensive gold floral and geometric bands decorate the robe and drape edges. A gold plaque belt circles the waist, with a narrow hanging strip decorated with round medallions and a gold tassel. Dark brown ankle-height leather boots are visible under the tunic.
